result:
I've made the change so a held Enter adds exactly one clip on all three paths: the library row, the global Enter on `body`, and ＋ დამატება. In my own Chromium run at 1280×720, all three went from 0 → 3 clips before the edit and 0 → 1 after. None of C's §3 browser checks are claimed yet; those are C's to run. Nothing is committed or pushed.

**Changes** (4 modified + 2 new, all hunks inside the allowed line ranges):
- **Library row** (`ArrangementLibrary.tsx`): `preventDefault` and `stopPropagation` still run on every Enter, but the select-and-add now runs only when `!event.repeat`.
- **Global Enter** (`StudioWorkspace.tsx`): the add runs only when `!event.repeat`, the same pattern as the Space branch.
- **＋ დამატება** (`ArrangementLibraryPreview.tsx`): a new `onKeyDown` calls `preventDefault()` on a repeated Enter, so the browser sends no click. There is no `stopPropagation`.
- **Doc 086**: only line 4 changed, to "C PASS (Round 98), გამოქვეყნდა 736db33".
- **New:** `held-enter-add.test.tsx` (tests HA1–HA8) and doc 087 (Georgian).
- **Repo state:** HEAD is still `736db33`, and the frozen list is 528/528 at start and end. End hashes are in `a-round-99/end-hashes.txt`.

**Checks run:**
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint`: both exit 0. Lint's 218 warnings are repository-wide; Biome on the four owned code files reports nothing.
- New test file: 8/8 pass.
- Targeted list (`a-round-99/targeted-list.txt`): 55 files, 969 tests, all pass.
- I did not run the full suite or `npm run verify`; those belong to the gate.

**Fail-before and mutations** (in scratch, `a-round-99/mut/`):
- Against the baseline snapshots, HA1, HA3, HA5 and HA8 fail, which is exactly what B expected.
- Mutations a–h each turn their named test red, and the unmutated control is 8/8.
- My first draft of HA6 also failed on the baseline because it checked that the Enter was prevented. I narrowed it to the propagation check, as in the round 98 TH4 case; HA5 still covers the prevention.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent gave 9/10 with no Critical or High findings. I fixed two of its nits (the `requestAnimationFrame` stub in the test, and explicit "source is ready" checks in HA3, HA4 and HA6), then re-ran the mutations and tests with identical results. Its architecture note for B, recorded verbatim in the report, proposes a separate task to build one shared test harness for the audio fakes, which are now copied into about 60 test files.

**Known gaps:**
- The browser evidence is Chromium only.
- Environments that send auto-repeat as `repeat=false` (VNC, some X11 setups, soft keyboards) still add one clip per repeat; this is the known doc 085 limit.
- A held Enter on ▶ მოუსმინე is still untested (`B-R98-H1-PREVIEW-TOGGLE-HOLD`).

**Next for C:**
- HOLD-ROW, HOLD-BODY and HOLD-PLUS at both viewports.
- At 1280 only: FRESH-ADD, HELD-ARROW-REG, SPACE-REG, CLOSE-HOLD-REG and EXPORT-REG.
- PX-NET, REG-HYD and G99-3; the fake-Bearer sub-check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- AN-REVIEW: re-run mutations a, b, c and g.
- T99-TARGETED and SOURCE-UNCHANGED.

The runner may overwrite `a-round-99-result.json` with its session output, so I saved a copy as `a-round-99/result-summary.json`.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `a-round-99.md`
- `a-round-99-result.json`
- `a-round-99/result-summary.json`
